code: const doc = await eda.dmt_SelectControl.getCurrentDocumentInfo(); if (doc.uuid !== '822ec5745398cfb8') return 'ABORT'; const comps = await eda.pcb_PrimitiveComponent.getAll(); const uDes = comps.map(c => c.getState_Designator()).filter(d => d && d.startsWith('U')); const uData = {}; for (const des of uDes) { const c = comps.find(k => k.getState_Designator() === des); const a = c.toAsync(); const rec = {comp: {x: c.getState_X(), y: c.getState_Y(), rot: c.getState_Rotation()}}; try { const pins = await a.getAllPins(); rec.pins = pins.map(p => ({x: p.x, y: p.y, num: p.padNumber, net: p.net, pad: p.pad, rot: p.rotation})); } catch(e) { rec.err = String(e); } try { const bb = await eda.pcb_Primitive.getPrimitivesBBox([c]); rec.bbox = {minX: bb.minX, minY: bb.minY, maxX: bb.maxX, maxY: bb.maxY}; } catch(e) { rec.bbErr = String(e); } uData[des] = rec; } return JSON.stringify(uData);
